name: Liminal Trial
summary:
Welcome to your first Liminal Trial.
You are tasked with assessing a house to determine whether it remains in its normal state or has entered an abnormal condition. Identify five correctly in a row and your task is complete. Fail, and the Collective will reset your progress again and again until stability is achieved.

Each shift could possibly reveal new changes around you, some are subtle so keep a keen eye, and some... are harder to explain.

There are twelve known deviations. How many will you uncover?
